children.text: The interested applicant should collect the application form from the District Central Cooperative Banks or its branches.

Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned authority..

schemeContent.briefDescription: A loan scheme provided by District Central Cooperative Banks for purchasing consumer durables like T.V., fridges, and two-wheelers. Loan covers 75% of the product cost at an interest rate of 14%.

children.text: The "District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Consumer Durables T.V., Fridge and Two Wheelers Loan" scheme launched by the Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department, Tamil Nadu, offers loans for the purchase of consumer durables, including T.V.s, refrigerators, and two-wheelers. The loan covers up to 75% of the product cost, with no upper ceiling, and is subject to a 14% interest rate (subject to change).
